fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami Beach adopting prohibition and the Volstead Act; discussion of a proposed local-option racing bill in the Florida legislature; criticism of municipal contracts and costs involving Florida Power & Light Company and Miami bus operations; comparisons of Miami and Jacksonville taxes, bonds, and utility rates; political and civic notes on Chamber of Commerce and city commission elections (including references to Ev Sewell), along with letters to the editor on city finances and public officials. Regular columns (e.g., "Little Geraldine," "Watt's Watt Round the Town") and advertisements appear throughout, including travel/excursion and railway promotions.
